What is Probability?

Probability is the numerical measure of the likelihood of an event occurring.

Why does Probability always lie between

0

and

1?

Because an event cannot be less likely than impossible (0) or more certain than certain (1).

What is Sample Space?

The complete set of all possible outcomes of an experiment.

What is the difference between

Independent

and

Dependent Events?

Independent Events

do not affect each other.

Dependent Events

change the probability of subsequent events.

Why is Complement Probability useful?

Because many difficult probability questions become easier by calculating

1−P(Event).

What is Conditional Probability?

It is the probability of an event occurring given that another event has already occurred.
